title: LoadShapesPolicy v1 — the load-shape measurement plan as data: the mesh sizes to measure, the steady-state window (virtual seconds of fresh heartbeats gossiped to convergence, again and again), the per-convergence round budget, and the Y-055 gossip + Y-054 liveness policies the measurement runs under; the law is schema constants — every count in a shape is counted by the components themselves or computed from their counts by a stated rule (counts_come_from_components always true), and the published numbers are simulator numbers that may never be cited as hardware proof (hardware_claim_allowed always false); the window must divide evenly by the liveness heartbeat interval and the gossip policy must be able to hold the largest planned size — both enforced by the measurer on top of this schema (Y-072)
